title: Seared Scallops
desc: Hand-dived king scallops seared to golden perfection in foaming brown butter, served with crisp samphire and a silken cauliflower puree on hand-thrown stoneware.
businessBrief: Focusing on rapid heat dynamics and oceanic textures, this sequence highlights artisanal freshness and delicate pan searing for fine dining and luxury seafood concepts.
